geometry: txid-2k (2,048 rows x 4,096 B, one table per bucket, 36 entries per row)
seal_policy: demo: n_archive=n_recent=1, archive_target=1, recent_floor=1, reorg_margin=1; mainnet run publishes archive 347499 and recent 347500-347501; genesis run publishes recent 0
independent_oracle: examples/fixtures/verify_fixture.py (Python standard library only) derives each 113-byte entry from the raw blocks and fifteen parent transactions
network: zcash-mainnet frozen vectors; loopback HTTP; no runtime external lookup
workload: one lookup per eligible transaction (14) after a warm-up lookup, plus absent, below-placement, foreign-codec, wrong-binding and unserved-revision controls; concurrency 1
limitations: Server protocol evidence only; trusted publisher; range, tier, bucket and timing leakage. No production capacity, cryptographic release, wallet recovery or Vizor qualification.
